compute_eigh_eigenvalues: compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a Hermitian matrix using eigh returning an EighResult namedtuple
decompose_matrix_qr: decompose a matrix into orthogonal Q and upper-triangular R factors using qr returning a QRResult namedtuple
compute_svd_decomposition: compute singular value decomposition of a matrix using svd returning U, S, Vh via SVDResult namedtuple
compute_matrix_rank: compute the effective rank of a matrix using svdvals and a tolerance threshold with matrix_rank
compute_matrix_inverse_pinv: compute the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of a matrix using pinv with optional relative tolerance rtol
compute_cholesky_factorization: compute the Cholesky factorization of a positive-definite matrix using cholesky with optional upper flag
compute_vector_norm: compute the norm of a vector array with configurable axis, ord, and keepdims using vector_norm
compute_matrix_norm: compute the norm of the last two axes of an array as a matrix norm using matrix_norm
compute_cross_product: compute the cross product of two arrays along a specified axis using cross
compute_outer_product: compute the outer product of two arrays using outer
compute_log_det_sign: compute the sign and natural log of the absolute value of the determinant using slogdet returning SlogdetResult
extract_singular_values: extract only the singular values of a matrix without U and Vh factors using svdvals
extract_diagonal_elements: extract the diagonal elements of the last two axes of a matrix using diagonal with optional offset
compute_matrix_trace: compute the trace of the last two axes of a matrix using trace with optional offset and dtype
create_eigh_result_namedtuple: create an EighResult namedtuple containing eigenvalues and eigenvectors arrays
create_qr_result_namedtuple: create a QRResult namedtuple containing Q and R factor arrays
create_slogdet_result_namedtuple: create a SlogdetResult namedtuple containing sign and logabsdet arrays
create_svd_result_namedtuple: create an SVDResult namedtuple containing U, S, and Vh arrays
